_comment: Upstream base of each vendored crate. DeskRally carries modified copies (see each DESKRALLY-CHANGES.md), so upstream fixes do not arrive through cargo. scripts/check-vendored-upstream.py reports newer upstream releases; review their changelogs and security advisories, then re-apply DeskRally's change on the newer base or note why not. Update base_version here when a fork is rebased.

crates.name: webrtc-ice
crates.deskrally_change: relay_dialer.rs hook: TURN over TCP and TLS

crates.name: webrtc-sctp
crates.deskrally_change: one failed UDP send no longer closes the association
